scoreboard.name: Predict-Then-Reveal Forced Cognitive Commitment Mechanics
scoreboard.synthesis_summary: Restricted mandatory prediction strictly to Step 1 conceptual hooks and high-stakes application gates (Steps 8 & 12). Incorporated an 800ms minimum dwell-time latency filter, a 2-tier metacognitive confidence toggle ('Just Guessing' vs 'Confident Hypothesis'), zero-shame curiosity amber borders, inline Turkish tooltips, and pre-allocated zero-CLS grid containers.

COG.mandate: Memory consolidation, cognitive load theory (Sweller), retrieval practice & spacing (Roediger, Bjork), hypercorrection effect (Butterfield & Metcalfe), schema formation.
COG.rationale: Perfect evidentiary grounding in the hypercorrection effect (Butterfield & Metcalfe) and retrieval-induced potentiation. Restricting commitment to Step 1 and mastery gates completely resolves my initial Round A concern regarding ego depletion and working memory saturation.

TEA.mandate: 12-stage mastery progression, pedagogical sequencing, misconception deconstruction, authentic clinical pharmacy relevance (EUS, hospital pharmacy rounds), bilingual classroom reality.
TEA.rationale: Mandatory Step 1 predict-then-reveal invariant is the bedrock of our 12-stage progression. It transforms passive slide reading into clinical problem-solving. Pre-rendered Turkish tooltips prevent foreign-language confusion.

GAM.mandate: Flow state (Csikszentmihalyi), agency, ludic tension, tactile micro-mechanics, predict-then-reveal stakes, immediate kinesthetic feedback loops, avoiding boring forms.
GAM.rationale: Creates immediate ludic tension and curiosity stakes before every concept reveal. While I originally advocated for predictions on more steps, gating it at Step 1 and milestone gates preserves flow without becoming an administrative barrier.

ADV.mandate: Student mental health, cognitive fatigue, 15-30 minute mobile study windows (metrobus transit), low-stress zero-shame environments, bilingual Turkish-English cognitive load.
ADV.rationale: The Phase 4 concessions completely rescued this feature for stressed students. Replacing punitive red 'Incorrect' banners with calm amber 'Curiosity Check (Zero Penalty)' badges removes exam shame and impostor syndrome during late-night study.

DAT.mandate: Psychometrics, Item Response Theory (IRT), Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT), Wald SPRT, telemetry granularity, distractor diagnostic power, measuring single-step normalized learning gains.
DAT.rationale: The 800ms dwell filter eliminates rapid-guess telemetry pollution. The 2-tier confidence toggle allows empirical tracking of hypercorrection gains while isolating true latent ability from 50/50 guessing artifacts in our BKT engine.

TEC.mandate: Client-side deterministic execution, WebAssembly, Service Worker & IndexedDB offline caching, zero layout thrashing (CLS = 0.00), bundle size optimization (<10KB widgets), zero runtime cloud API costs.
TEC.rationale: Architecturally flawless. Pre-allocating container height via CSS Grid achieves mathematically verified CLS = 0.00. The pure client-side deterministic state machine requires zero Cloud Function invocations and zero external dependencies.

ECO.mandate: Cost-to-build, developer ROI, 93%+ gross margins, freemium conversion funnel, commercial defensibility, curriculum authoring scale across 22 modules, ruthless subtraction of UI bloat.
ECO.rationale: Highest return on invested engineering dollar of any interaction in e-learning history. Slashes Lesson 1 bounce rates, anchors the permanent freemium tier, and executes 100% on the client to preserve >93% gross margins.

dissent_analysis.divergence_summary: Unanimous sovereign consensus across all 7 seats. Minor initial friction between GAM (who wanted continuous predictions) and ADV/COG (who warned against fatigue) was harmoniously resolved by gating mandatory predictions at Step 1 and mastery steps.
dissent_analysis.minority_caveats: DAT notes that while the 800ms dwell filter protects against rapid tapping, learners operating on desktop mice may still trigger false rapid guesses if reading speed is extremely high.
dissent_analysis.operational_conditions: Must enforce the 800ms dwell-time threshold client-side before registering BKT ability calibrations.
dissent_analysis.binding_guardrails: Strictly forbid red punitive styling or negative XP deductions on Step 1 prediction failures across all lessons.

scoreboard.name: Dynamic Henderson-Hasselbalch pH-Compartment Ionization & Permeability Chamber

TEA.mandate: 12-stage mastery progression, pedagogical sequencing, misconception deconstruction, authentic clinical pharmacy relevance (EUS, hospital pharmacy rounds), bilingual classroom reality.

GAM.mandate: Flow state (Csikszentmihalyi), agency, ludic tension, tactile micro-mechanics, predict-then-reveal stakes, immediate kinesthetic feedback loops, avoiding boring forms.
GAM.rationale: Clinical rescue challenges provide clear stakes, goal-oriented urgency, and visceral feedback. Discrete snap-points give physical tactile satisfaction to what was previously boring textbook math.

ADV.mandate: Student mental health, cognitive fatigue, 15-30 minute mobile study windows (metrobus transit), low-stress zero-shame environments, bilingual Turkish-English cognitive load.
ADV.rationale: Collapsing dual compartments into responsive mobile tabs and 48px touch targets resolved transit usability bugs. Some lingering math anxiety remains for students struggling with logs, requiring careful progressive hints.

DAT.mandate: Psychometrics, Item Response Theory (IRT), Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT), Wald SPRT, telemetry granularity, distractor diagnostic power, measuring single-step normalized learning gains.
DAT.rationale: Discrete physiological snap-points (pH 1.5, 5.5, 7.4, 8.0) replace noisy continuous drag telemetry with clean, interpretable decision logs that map directly into our BKT skill mastery parameters.

TEC.mandate: Client-side deterministic execution, WebAssembly, Service Worker & IndexedDB offline caching, zero layout thrashing (CLS = 0.00), bundle size optimization (<10KB widgets), zero runtime cloud API costs.

dissent_analysis.minority_caveats: ADV emphasized that on small phone screens (<360px width), the tabbed compartment toggle must always indicate the currently hidden compartment's equilibrium status with an unobtrusive pill badge.
dissent_analysis.operational_conditions: Must provide discrete snap-point detents at physiological pH values (1.5, 5.5, 7.4, 8.0) to prevent unconstrained continuous slider scrolling.

scoreboard.name: Scaffolded 3-Tier Hint Ladder (Nudge -> Clue -> Solution)
scoreboard.consensus_tier: Tier II: High Strategic Consensus (Signature Pillar)
scoreboard.synthesis_summary: Upgraded into the Calibrated 3-Tier Scaffolding Engine. Implemented reflection cooldowns (5s between Tier 1 and 2; 10s before Tier 3) to eliminate rapid-fire gaming. Tier 3 features interactive faded completion (never naked answers). Telemetry utilizes a calibrated partial-credit BKT model (1.0 unassisted, 0.7 nudge, 0.4 clue, 0.0 worked example). Hints pre-bundled as obfuscated client JSON for 100% offline availability; CI linters enforce strict word limits.

TEA.mandate: 12-stage mastery progression, pedagogical sequencing, misconception deconstruction, authentic clinical pharmacy relevance (EUS, hospital pharmacy rounds), bilingual classroom reality.
TEA.rationale: Backward-faded completion on Tier 3 ensures students make the final deductive leap themselves rather than passively copying formulas. Highly authentic instructional scaffolding.

GAM.mandate: Flow state (Csikszentmihalyi), agency, ludic tension, tactile micro-mechanics, predict-then-reveal stakes, immediate kinesthetic feedback loops, avoiding boring forms.
GAM.rationale: Cooldown delays establish a tangible tactical economy. However, hint consumption remains an assistive mechanism rather than a thrilling gameplay loop, keeping engagement solid but slightly below dynamic sandboxes.

ADV.mandate: Student mental health, cognitive fatigue, 15-30 minute mobile study windows (metrobus transit), low-stress zero-shame environments, bilingual Turkish-English cognitive load.
ADV.rationale: An indispensable lifeline for students studying in isolation past midnight. Eliminates dead-end frustration and academic shame. The non-punitive framing encourages students to seek help when stuck.

DAT.mandate: Psychometrics, Item Response Theory (IRT), Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT), Wald SPRT, telemetry granularity, distractor diagnostic power, measuring single-step normalized learning gains.
DAT.rationale: The discounted latent credit model (1.0 / 0.7 / 0.4 / 0.0) protects IRT and BKT measurement integrity. Logging exact hint depth transitions provides invaluable formative diagnostic intelligence.

TEC.mandate: Client-side deterministic execution, WebAssembly, Service Worker & IndexedDB offline caching, zero layout thrashing (CLS = 0.00), bundle size optimization (<10KB widgets), zero runtime cloud API costs.
TEC.rationale: Pre-bundling obfuscated client-side strings eliminates server round-trip latency, prevents cheating via basic dev tools, and guarantees flawless offline operation during network drops.

ECO.mandate: Cost-to-build, developer ROI, 93%+ gross margins, freemium conversion funnel, commercial defensibility, curriculum authoring scale across 22 modules, ruthless subtraction of UI bloat.
ECO.rationale: Standardizing 3-tier hint authoring templates with automated CI linting prevents curriculum authoring cost overruns. Offering Tier 1 free and Tiers 2-3 in the pass creates an organic conversion hook.

dissent_analysis.divergence_summary: Strong consensus across pedagogy, measurement, and student advocacy. GAM scored slightly lower (45/55) on engagement due to cooldown friction, but acknowledged that cooldowns are pedagogically essential to prevent rapid-fire clicking.
dissent_analysis.minority_caveats: GAM noted that cooldown timers must display a gentle pulsing countdown animation rather than a static frozen button to prevent user confusion.
dissent_analysis.operational_conditions: Enforce automated CI linters verifying word ceilings (Tier 1 <= 15 words, Tier 2 <= 25 words, Tier 3 <= 40 words) on all authored hints.
dissent_analysis.binding_guardrails: Tier 3 must never display the final naked answer string; it must provide a faded worked derivation requiring active completion.
